g.text: Varma has a rule for briefings: the people in the room get the standing orders, a summary of the case,
the documents that matter today, and the minutes of the last meeting. Nothing else. "A briefing that
holds everything holds nothing." She wants LANTERN briefed the same way, and she wants to see exactly
what it was told, word for word.
. The model's chat template: how roles become text
Ollama ships this Go template with the model
. It turns the list of messages into one string with
Counts are measured, not estimated: each row is the increase in prompt tokens reported by Ollama when that
part is added. Template markers are counted with the part they wrap.
You are LANTERN, the evidence workstation of the Economic Offences Wing. Answer only from the documents in
. If the documents do not answer, reply NOT IN EVIDENCE.<|im_end|>
Late again. I have been through every Northwind invoice since September. Northwind is not a vendor. It has no
ships, no staff and no office, only a PO box in Port Sabran and an account at Sabran Mercantile Bank. No VAT
number on a single invoice. Every payment is coded to Raj's cost centre, and every invoice is dated while Raj
is in Port Sabran. I have not told Elena. I do not know yet who I can tell.
How much has Halcyon paid Northwind Freight in total this year, and what did Reyes write about Northwind? List
. Proof: the chat API sends exactly this text
prompt tokens | our rendered text sent raw:
Halcyon paid Northwind Freight a total of 227,700 KBD (Kestrel Bay dollar) in 2026, as shown by the
Reyes wrote in the margin of the invoice: "Not a vendor."
answer via the raw rendered text
Halcyon paid Northwind Freight a total of 255,700 KBD (Kestrel Bay dollar) in 2026, as shown by the
Reyes wrote in the margin of the invoice: "Not a vendor."
Same tokens in. Read the two totals. If they differ, the input was identical and the model still answered
. Do not ask the model to do the arithmetic. Put the result in the context.
answer with the computed total in the context
Halcyon paid Northwind Freight a total of 227,700.00 KBD (Kestrel Bay dollar) in total for the months of
January, February, and March. Reyes wrote in the margin of the invoice that "Not a vendor." The invoices
Code adds up money exactly, every time. The model's job is to read and explain.
Three Northwind invoices: NW-0388 for 62,500.00, NW-0402 for 71,200.00 and NW-0419 for 94,000.00. That
is 227,700.00 Kestrel Bay dollars in ten weeks to a company Reyes described as "not a vendor". None of
the invoices carries a VAT number. All three are payable to the same account at Sabran Mercantile Bank.
LANTERN listed the invoices correctly. The total did not hold: the same tokens at temperature 0 produced
one figure through the chat endpoint and another through the raw text, and only the computed total is
reliable. It also wrote that Reyes put "Not a vendor" in the margin of an invoice; the briefing says the
margin note was on a ledger page. Varma looks at the token table longer than at the answer. "So this is
everything it knew. Good. Then everything it said can be checked."
